# US Consumer Sentiment Falls in August

The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment index fell to 51 in early August 2026, down from 55.2 in July and below market expectations of 54.5, ending two consecutive months of improvement.

Both major components weakened, with the current conditions index declining to 51.8 and the expectations measure falling to 50.6.
